writeup: Woot has a 24-pack of Amazon Basics 14 inch laptop and tablet shoulder bags for $29.99, new, which works out to about $1.25 per bag. The same 24-pack sells for $88 at Base Trend. Each black polyester bag fits devices up to 14.1 inches and has a padded main compartment, front pocket, shoulder strap, grab handles and a luggage pass-through. Limit one per customer and quantity is very low.
